{{Quote|Not only are these people keeping tabs on what's happening in the black spots of the galaxy, but they're helping knit them back together again, too.|[[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]]|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic III: Reunion">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic III: Reunion]]''</ref>}}
The '''Ryn Network''' or '''Ryn Syndicate''' (a.k.a. '''Gatherers''') was an intelligence organization that was founded by a [[Ryn/Legends|Ryn]] named [[Droma]] during the height of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. The syndicate operated on the loosest possible implementation of the cell system, planting the often-ignored Ryn [[Species/Legends|species]] within vital parts of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], where they would pick up on information that could later be put to use aiding the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]. Using a number of covert operatives who used their skills to leave hints and notes in places they were sure to be found, the Ryn Network led [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] to several bubbling hot-spots of [[Yuuzhan Vong]] infiltration and manipulation. With their aid, [[Solo family/Legends|the Solos]] were able to solve the crises on [[Galantos]], [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] and [[Esfandia/Legends|Esfandia]], at the same time improving relations with the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].
